Hi team — thanks for the ping. Confirm we can provide a redacted pen test executive summary and a formal vulnerability management SLA. Key points to include in our reply: 

Pen test artifact policy:
- We do NOT share full, unredacted penetration test reports publicly. For procurement we provide a redacted executive summary that includes scope, high-level findings, and remediation status. Sensitive exploit details are removed.

Vulnerability management SLA (recommended wording):
- Critical: remediation/mitigation target = 7 business days from detection
- High: remediation target = 30 calendar days from detection
- Medium: remediation target = 90 calendar days from detection
- Scanning cadence: external 3rd-party pen test annually (or after major release/infra change); external vulnerability scan quarterly; internal automated scans weekly with periodic manual triage.
- Disclosure policy: coordinated disclosure; we notify impacted customers and relevant parties after remediation with CVE references as appropriate. We do not publish raw exploit PoCs.

Attachments I will provide: redwood-pen-test-summary-2026-06.pdf (redacted), Vuln_Management_SLA.docx. Both are safe to share after minimal redaction and under NDA if customer requests.

For engineering follow-up: Dev is the primary SE for FinHealth; if the customer requests a deeper technical session, we can schedule a 30-45 minute call with infra/SE + security.

— Rishi
Director, Security & Compliance
rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com
